name: Madou Souhei Kleinhasa
original_name: 魔動装兵クラインハーゼ
source:
The land is in a state of war. Having conquered other countries, Desutona turned towards Froia, a presumably easy target. However, their invasion was halted by a troop of Froian magic wielders. Faced with this resistance, Desutona changed tactics by deploying tentacles to capture these soldiers and sap them of their magic... 

[Edited From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20090909235306/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1013500]ErogeShop[/url]]
translation:
大陆正处于战争之中。德斯托纳征服其他国家后，把目光投向看似容易攻取的弗洛伊亚。然而，弗洛伊亚的一支魔法士兵部队阻止了入侵。面对顽强抵抗，德斯托纳改变战术，派出触手捕获这些士兵，夺取她们的魔力…
